thread:
Sasha (eng-runtime): ok following the postmortem, wanted to start a single thread for tracking remediation items for the chat/streaming reliability issues (timeouts / partial responses / reconnect behavior). linking the postmortem: https://redwood.internal/pm/streaming-2026 (see summary below)

Kevin H (eng-sre): noted. can we list owners + realistic deadlines? also want recurring-pattern checks added to oncall runbook. :eyes:

Maria G (eng-platform): I've surfaced the KV cache timeout anomaly in the runtime logs — see the snippet I posted in the doc. suspect default idle close is too aggressive for long-lived streams.

Oliver (oncall): observed ~7 partial-response spikes between 03:10-03:40 UTC during the incident. attaching short log extract: ```
[03:12:07] stream_conn id=34 -> client_reset
[03:12:08] partial_send id=34 tokens=120
[03:12:08] conn_drop id=34 reason=timeout
```

Priya (product): customers hit UX problems when partial responses arrive then reconnect drops — want graceful client retries. Can engineering estimate impact of adding resumable streams vs simple reconnect?

Sasha (eng-runtime): agreed. proposed remediation items: 1) server-side keepalive/ping + extend idle to 90s (owner: Maria, due: 2026-04-05) 2) add explicit partial-response markers + end-of-stream sentinel so clients can detect truncated responses (owner: Kevin, due: 2026-03-30) 3) client reconnect strategy doc + SDK change: exponential backoff + resume token support (owner: Sasha, due: 2026-04-12) 4) alerting rule for partial-response rate >0.5% per minute (owner: Oliver, due: 2026-03-28) 5) one-week canary rollout and perf regression evals (owner: Maria & Sasha, due: 2026-04-20).

Kevin H (eng-sre): thanks. quick notes: for #2 we should also emit a stream-sequence header so we can correlate resumes. will sketch the header format: `X-Stream-Seq: <session-id>:<segment>` and add to logs. I'll own the RFC and implementation.

Maria G (eng-platform): for #1 I'll update the runtime config and ops toggle. plan: default 30s -> 90s for streaming group; gated by canary. will add a feature flag.

Oliver (oncall): for alerting (#4) I'll add Grafana rule and a PagerDuty policy to notify on-call if sustained partial rates. also recommend adding a daily CI job that runs 1000 short streams to detect regressions.

Priya (product): timeline OK but can we prioritize partial-response sentinel + client reconnect doc before canary? UX depends on it. :+1:

Sasha (eng-runtime): agreed, reprioritizing: move #2 and #3 earlier. new internal deadlines: #2 (Kevin) -> 2026-03-28, #3 (Sasha) -> 2026-04-02. I'll update the tracker.

Kevin H (eng-sre): doing a quick feasibility check: resume tokens require idempotent generation on server side — may need small changes to model runner state handling. if complexity >2d, fallback to clear reconnect with sequence header. I'll report EOD.

Oncall Bot: Incident INC-2026-031: severity reduced to S2. All follow-ups recorded.

Sasha (eng-runtime): ACTIONS (summary for tracker):
- Maria: runtime idle extension + keepalive (due 2026-04-05)
- Kevin: stream-seq header + partial sentinel RFC + implement (due 2026-03-28)
- Sasha: SDK reconnect strategy + resume client prototype (due 2026-04-02)
- Oliver: alerting + daily regression job (due 2026-03-28)
- Everyone: coordinate canary testing week starting 2026-04-15

Maria G (eng-platform): I'll push a config PR today and tag reviewers. please add acceptance criteria to the tracker (canary traffic shape, latency SLO unaffected).

Kevin H (eng-sre): EOD update: RFC draft done, complexity looks 3-4 dev days if we do resume tokens; fallback plan 1-2 days. I'll pick final approach after quick spike tomorrow. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Oliver (oncall): FYI adding recurring-check item to runbook: "If partial-response >0.3% for 3 consecutive 10m windows -> severity review". tagging pagerduty policy to escalate to SRE lead.

Priya (product): will prepare customer communication template in case canary reveals regressions. also want product-owner signoff before full rollout.

Sasha (eng-runtime): thanks all. I'll update the postmortem follow-up checklist and create the tracker tickets. ping me in thread for any blockers. :thumbsup:

Kevin H (eng-sre): ping @Sasha (eng-runtime) — posted spike results, resume tokens feasible. moving forward with tokens + seq header. will open PR 2026-03-26.

Maria G (eng-platform): PR opened for keepalive config: https://git.internal/repo/PR/4821. reviewers: @Sasha @Oliver.

Oliver (oncall): added Grafana alert: "streaming_partial_rate_high" and tied to PD. confirming runbook entry created.

Sasha (eng-runtime): noted. closing loop: next checklist sync 2026-03-29 16:00 UTC to verify progress and unblock any devs.
